response.sql: WITH color_quantities AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantity FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), totals AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity_per_color, SUM(quantity) AS overall_quantity FROM color_quantities) SELECT AVG(c.quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(c.quantity * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.overall_quantity, 0)) AS average_share, AVG(c.quantity - t.average_quantity_per_color) AS average_excess FROM color_quantities AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE c.quantity > t.average_quantity_per_color;
